scope: Python and JavaScript SDK offset pagination parity
issue: A non-page-aligned offset such as 10 with a limit of 25 was converted to page 1, returning rows from the beginning instead of starting at row 10.
change: Both clients now pass the exact offset to Directus when offset and a non-zero limit are provided. Explicit page handling and the existing zero-limit guard remain unchanged.
directus_sdk_contract: The locked @directus/sdk v17 Query type supports an offset field.
